changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE result SET correction_round = ranked.new_round FROM (SELECT r.id, COALESCE(affected.prior_max_round + 1, 0) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.submission_id ORDER BY r.id) - 1 AS new_round FROM result r JOIN (SELECT first_without_round.submission_id, first_without_round.first_id, (SELECT MAX(prior.correction_round) FROM result prior WHERE prior.submission_id = first_without_round.submission_id AND prior.id < first_without_round.first_id AND prior.assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC')) AS prior_max_round FROM (SELECT submission_id, MIN(id) AS first_id FROM result WHERE submission_id IS NOT NULL AND correction_round IS NULL AND assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC') GROUP BY submission_id) first_without_round) affected ON affected.submission_id = r.submission_id WHERE r.id >= affected.first_id AND r.assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC')) AS ranked WHERE result.id = ranked.id

UPDATE result JOIN (SELECT r.id, COALESCE(affected.prior_max_round + 1, 0) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.submission_id ORDER BY r.id) - 1 AS new_round FROM result r JOIN (SELECT first_without_round.submission_id, first_without_round.first_id, (SELECT MAX(prior.correction_round) FROM result prior WHERE prior.submission_id = first_without_round.submission_id AND prior.id < first_without_round.first_id AND prior.assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC')) AS prior_max_round FROM (SELECT submission_id, MIN(id) AS first_id FROM result WHERE submission_id IS NOT NULL AND correction_round IS NULL AND assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC') GROUP BY submission_id) first_without_round) affected ON affected.submission_id = r.submission_id WHERE r.id >= affected.first_id AND r.assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC')) AS ranked ON result.id = ranked.id SET result.correction_round = ranked.new_round
